title: Senior Recruiter
description:
**Role: Senior Recruiter** 




**Location: Bangalore** 




**Experience: 2–4 Years** 




**Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Preferred** 



 Job Summary
 
 We are looking for an experienced and proactive Senior Recruitment Consultant with 2–4 years of experience in end\-to\-end recruitment, client coordination, and recruitment consulting. The ideal candidate should have strong recruitment delivery experience, excellent communication skills, and exposure to HR Operations. The role involves managing client requirements, coordinating with candidates, and ensuring timely closure of positions.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing and screening to interview coordination, selection, and onboarding.
* Handle IT and technical recruitment requirements and ensure timely closure of positions.
* Coordinate with clients to understand hiring requirements, job descriptions, and skill expectations.
* Provide recruitment consulting and support clients in identifying suitable candidates.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships through regular communication and follow\-ups.
* Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, employee referrals, and other recruitment channels.
* Conduct initial candidate screening and coordinate interviews with clients and hiring managers.
* Manage candidate pipelines, recruitment trackers, MIS reports, and hiring updates.
* Coordinate with internal teams and clients to ensure smooth recruitment operations.
* Support recruitment targets and ensure quality candidate delivery.
* Gain exposure to HR Operations, including onboarding, employee documentation, attendance, leave management, and exit formalities.
* Support basic HR operational activities and employee lifecycle processes as required.


 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 * Strong hands\-on experience in end\-to\-end recruitment.
* Experience in client coordination, client handling, and recruitment consulting.
* Exposure to HR Operations and employee lifecycle management.
* Good knowledge of Naukri, LinkedIn, and other recruitment platforms.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple recruitment requirements independently.


 Preferred Candidate Profile
 * Experience in recruitment consultancy or staffing services.
* Strong recruitment delivery and client handling experience.
* Exposure to HR Operations, including onboarding, employee documentation, and employee coordination.
* Target\-oriented and proactive approach.
* Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period are preferred.

title: Founding Recruiter, India
description:
**About Cartesia**
 Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.
   

  

 We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large\-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design\-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.
   

  

 We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90\+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re looking for our first Recruiter based in India, to help us scale our tech, go\-to\-market and business teams with the same thoughtfulness and precision that defines our US hiring. You’ll be responsible for identifying and hiring top talent across multiple functions including research, engineering, sales, marketing, operations, and customer success — partnering closely with leadership and helping shape how we tell the Cartesia story to the world.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact, hands\-on role for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced startup environment and brings a mix of scrappiness, strategy, and care to every hire.
   

  

 Your Impact
   

  

* Own full\-cycle recruiting for all Bangalore\-based roles, from sourcing to close
* Help to scale our interview processes in the country, including interview plans, rubrics and assessment criteria
* Partner with hiring managers to deeply understand each team’s goals and build tailored hiring strategies
* Craft compelling outreach and deliver an exceptional candidate experience that reflects Cartesia’s culture and mission
* Build diverse, high\-quality pipelines through sourcing, referrals, and creative channels
* Manage the interview process end\-to\-end, ensuring a smooth, inclusive, and thoughtful candidate journey
* Track hiring metrics and use data to refine processes and improve outcomes


 What You Bring
   

  

* 4\+ years of experience in tech, GTM or business recruiting, ideally at a high\-growth startup
* A proven track record of sourcing exceptional talent, and strong candidate engagement skills
* Ability to manage multiple searches at once, often with evolving needs
* Clear communication, attention to detail, and a high bar for candidate experience
* Comfort working with ambiguity and adapting quickly as we scale
* Bonus: experience recruiting at an AI\-focussed company


**More Details**
 🏢
 **In\-office policy:** 
 We’re an in\-person team based out of offices in 🇺🇸 San Francisco, 🇬🇧 London and 🇮🇳 Bangalore. We love being in the office, hanging out together, and learning from each other every day.
   

  

**🌎 Visa sponsorship:** 
 We provide visa sponsorship support and assess each circumstance on a case\-by\-case basis. However, visa sponsorship is dependent on many factors, including the role you are applying for, and the location you are going to be based, and so we can't always guarantee success. Your Recruiter will work with you to understand your visa sponsorship needs from the first call.
   

  

 🚢
 **We ship fast.** 
 All of our work is novel and cutting edge, and execution speed is paramount. We have a high bar, and we don’t sacrifice quality or design along the way.
   

  

 🤝
 **We support each other.** 
 We have an open \& inclusive culture that’s focused on giving everyone the resources they need to succeed.
   

  

**Our Benefits (US Employees Only)**
 💰
 **Compensation** 
 Competitive base salary alongside attractive equity package.
   

  

 🩺
 **Health Insurance** 
 Fully covered medical insurance along with dental and vision for you and your family.
   

  

 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒
 **Parental Leave** 
 9 weeks paternity \& 12 weeks maternity leave
   

  

 🏦
 **401(k)**
 🚆
 **Commuter Allowance** 
 A monthly stipend to help you get to and from the office.
   

  

 🏖️
 **Flexible PTO** 
 Take as much time as you need to recharge your batteries.
   

  

 🍲
 **Meals \& Snacks** 
 Lunch, dinner and plenty of snacks, provided daily.

title: Principal Recruiter
description:
**About The Team**
 Walmart’s Talent Acquisition team is at the forefront of building a future\-ready workforce. We are a passionate and strategic team dedicated to identifying, engaging, and hiring exceptional talent that powers our business and serves millions of customers every day.
   

  

 As part of the Leadership Talent Acquisition team, you will play a critical role in shaping Walmart’s technology leadership organization by identifying and attracting exceptional leaders from across the global technology ecosystem. You will work closely with senior executives and technology leaders to build leadership talent strategies, strengthen succession pipelines, and hire high\-impact talent across Walmart Global Tech.
   

  

 This role will have a strong focus on Director, Senior/ Group Director, Distinguished Engineer, Fellow and other senior technical leadership roles, requiring deep expertise in executive search, passive talent engagement, market intelligence, talent mapping and strategic stakeholder management.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

 Lead Senior Leadership Hiring
   

  

 Own end\-to\-end recruitment for Director, Senior/ Group Director, Distinguished Engineer, Fellow and other senior leadership and critical technology roles across Walmart Global Tech.
   

  

 Partner directly with senior executives, VPs, hiring managers and HR leadership to understand business strategy, organization design, workforce plans and leadership talent requirements.
   

  

 Translate complex business and technology needs into targeted leadership hiring strategies and compelling talent propositions.
   

  

 Lead highly confidential and business\-critical searches with a strong focus on quality, speed, candidate experience and organizational fit.
   

  

 Build Executive Talent Strategies \& Pipelines
   

  

 Develop proactive talent strategies for critical leadership and future capability needs rather than relying solely on active applicants.
   

  

 Build and maintain deep, diverse and market\-mapped leadership talent pools across India and global technology markets.
   

  

 Identify and engage passive leadership talent from leading technology companies, global capability centers, startups and emerging technology organizations.
   

  

 Develop long\-term relationships with senior technology executives and high\-caliber technical leaders, including candidates who may not be actively seeking opportunities.
   

  

 Build succession\-ready external talent pipelines for strategic and hard\-to\-fill leadership positions.
   

  

 Executive Search \& Talent Mapping
   

  

 Conduct sophisticated research and talent mapping across technology ecosystems to identify relevant leadership talent.
   

  

 Leverage executive search methodologies, market intelligence, professional networks, AI\-enabled sourcing tools and industry relationships to identify exceptional talent.
   

  

 Develop talent maps covering leadership capabilities, organizational structures, technology expertise, career progression and relevant market pools.
   

  

 Build targeted competitive intelligence on talent movements, leadership changes, organizational expansions, layoffs, acquisitions and emerging technology hubs.
   

  

 Establish relationships with senior leaders and external talent communities to strengthen Walmart’s leadership talent brand.
   

  

 Strategic Stakeholder Partnership
   

  

 Act as a trusted talent advisor to senior business and technology leaders, providing insights beyond the recruitment process.
   

  

 Challenge hiring assumptions constructively and influence decisions through data, market intelligence and talent availability.
   

  

 Consult with leaders on talent strategy, role calibration, market positioning, compensation considerations and competitive hiring dynamics.
   

  

 Establish clear search strategies, candidate profiles, assessment expectations and decision\-making frameworks at the beginning of each search.
   

  

 Facilitate alignment across multiple senior stakeholders and ensure disciplined governance throughout the hiring process.
   

  

 Candidate Engagement \& Experience
   

  

 Personally engage and build relationships with senior candidates throughout the hiring journey.
   

  

 Develop compelling, personalized value propositions for leadership candidates based on their career aspirations, technology interests and leadership impact.
   

  

 Serve as a trusted advisor to candidates while maintaining confidentiality and professionalism throughout the process.
   

  

 Deliver a differentiated, high\-touch "white\-glove" candidate experience for senior leadership hires.
   

  

 Effectively manage complex offer discussions, compensation expectations, counteroffers and closing strategies.
   

  

 Market Intelligence \& Talent Insights
   

  

 Provide senior leadership with actionable insights on technology talent markets, competitor organizations, leadership movements and compensation trends.
   

  

 Track market availability and competitiveness for critical leadership capabilities.
   

  

 Analyze candidate response, conversion, offer acceptance and hiring trends to continuously improve leadership recruiting strategies.
   

  

 Develop data\-driven recommendations to improve Walmart's ability to attract and hire senior technology talent.
   

  

 Build strong understanding of technology domains including AI/ML, Cloud, Data, Software Engineering, Platforms, Infrastructure, Product Engineering and emerging technologies.
   

  

 Thought Leadership \& Team Capability
   

  

 Serve as a subject matter expert and thought leader for leadership talent acquisition within the organization.
   

  

 Mentor and coach recruiters on advanced sourcing, executive engagement, stakeholder management and closing strategies.
   

  

 Share market intelligence, sourcing strategies, candidate insights and best practices across the Talent Acquisition organization.
   

  

 Contribute to building scalable leadership hiring frameworks, playbooks and talent intelligence capabilities.
   

  

 Represent Walmart Global Tech externally as a talent ambassador and strengthen relationships with senior technology talent communities.
   

  

 Governance \& Operational Excellence
   

  

 Ensure all leadership hiring activities follow Walmart's recruiting processes, compliance requirements and governance standards.
   

  

 Maintain accurate and timely recruitment data within ATS and talent management systems.
   

  

 Establish disciplined search governance, including search strategy, pipeline reviews, interview progress, decision tracking and closure.
   

  

 Use recruitment analytics and funnel metrics to identify opportunities for improving search effectiveness and hiring outcomes.
   

  

 What You’ll Bring
   

  

 15\+ years of progressive Talent Acquisition / Executive Search experience, with significant experience hiring senior technology leadership.
   

  

 Proven experience recruiting Director, Senior Director, VP, Distinguished Engineer, Fellow or equivalent senior technology leadership talent.
   

  

 Demonstrated success managing complex, confidential and high\-impact leadership searches.
   

  

 Strong understanding of the global technology talent ecosystem and leadership talent markets, particularly across India.
   

  

 Deep expertise in executive sourcing, passive candidate engagement, talent mapping and market intelligence.
   

  

 Strong network among senior technology professionals and leaders across leading technology companies, global capability centers, startups and emerging technology organizations.
   

  

 Ability to understand complex technology organizations, architectures, products and engineering capabilities and translate them into effective talent strategies.
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to influence and advise senior executives and hiring leaders using data, market insights and sound talent judgment.
   

  

 Strong executive presence with exceptional communication, relationship\-building, negotiation and influencing skills.
   

  

 Experience managing complex stakeholder groups across business, technology, HR, compensation and Talent Acquisition.
   

  

 Strong understanding of executive compensation, competitive talent dynamics and offer negotiation strategies.
   

  

 Proficiency with ATS platforms, talent intelligence tools, LinkedIn and AI\-enabled sourcing/recruiting technologies.
   

  

 Strong analytical skills with the ability to convert recruiting data and market intelligence into actionable recommendations.
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to operate independently, manage multiple strategic searches and deliver results in a fast\-paced, highly matrixed environment.
   

  

 High degree of confidentiality, integrity, discretion and professionalism when handling sensitive leadership searches.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Experience recruiting senior technology leaders within large\-scale global technology organizations.
   

  

 Experience partnering with C\-suite, VP\-level stakeholders.
   

  

 Experience building leadership talent pools and succession pipelines proactively.
   

  

 Exposure to hiring across multiple geographies and relocating global technology talent into India.
   

  

 Experience using AI, talent intelligence platforms and data\-driven sourcing methodologies to identify and engage executive talent.
   

  

 Experience in building executive talent communities and long\-term relationships with senior technology leaders.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 In this role, success goes beyond filling open positions. You will be expected to:
   

  

 Build a strong and sustainable pipeline of senior technology leadership talent.
   

  

 Increase Walmart's access to high\-caliber passive leadership talent.
   

  

 Deliver exceptional candidates for the most strategically important technology roles.
   

  

 Become a trusted talent advisor to senior technology leadership.
   

  

 Bring actionable external market intelligence into leadership hiring decisions.
   

  

 Strengthen Walmart's ability to attract, engage and close senior technology leaders in a highly competitive market.
   

  

 Build scalable approaches for identifying and engaging future leadership talent before positions become open.
   

  

 Elevate the candidate experience for senior leadership and executive\-level hiring.
   

  

**About Walmart Global Tech**
 Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people\-led and tech\-empowered.
   

  

 We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
   

  

 Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our \[Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best\-in\-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
   

  

 Belonging
   

  

 We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
   

  

 At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity Employer
   

  

 Walmart, Inc., is an Equal Opportunities Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.
   

  

 Minimum Qualifications...Outlined below are the required minimum qualifications for this position. If none are listed, there are no minimum qualifications.
   

  

 Option 1: Bachelor's degree in business, human resources, or related area and 3 years' experience in human resources, talent acquisition, or other area.
   

  

 Option 2: 5 years' experience in human resources, talent acquisition, or related area.
   

  

 Preferred Qualifications...Outlined below are the optional preferred qualifications for this position. If none are listed, there are no preferred qualifications.
   

  

 Professional in Human Resources certification

title: Talent Delivery & Recruitment Manager
description:
**Company Description**
  

**Work with Us. Change the World.**
  

 At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.
   

  

 There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.
   

  

 We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.
   

  

**Job Description**
  

 This is not your average recruitment management role. You will be leading a large, talented team of recruitment specialists, owning the delivery of high\-volume hiring across some of the most ambitious construction supervision projects in the Middle East. You will be the driving force behind a function that is critical to project success and you will have the autonomy, support, and resources to do it your way.
   

  

 If you are someone who leads from the front, builds trusted relationships with ease, and never misses a deadline, this role was made for you.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
  

 Leading Your Team
   

* Manage, coach, and inspire a large team of senior recruitment specialists
* Drive individual and team performance through clear KPIs, regular reviews, and a culture of accountability
* Develop your team's capabilities, creating clear pathways for growth and progression
* Oversee workload distribution to ensure consistent, high\-quality delivery across all requisitions
  


 Owning Recruitment Delivery
   

* Take full ownership of end\-to\-end high\-volume recruitment for construction supervision and technical engineering roles
* Develop and execute innovative sourcing strategies across job boards, social media, ATS platforms, and professional networks
* Lead proactive talent mapping and pipeline building to stay ahead of business demand
* Ensure the team consistently hits deadlines without compromising on quality
  


 Driving Performance \& Metrics
   

* Define and monitor team\-wide KPIs and recruitment metrics, maintaining full visibility of delivery performance
* Produce insightful reports for the Head of Talent Acquisition MEA on pipeline health, time\-to\-fill, offer acceptance rates, and more
* Identify performance gaps early and implement swift, effective solutions
* Champion data integrity across all ATS and recruitment reporting system
  


**Qualifications**
  

**Essential**
* Proven experience leading and managing large recruitment teams within a consultancy or RPO environment
* Extensive background in high\-volume recruitment, ideally within construction, engineering, or technical disciplines
* Demonstrable track record of managing KPIs, metrics, and performance reporting
* Strong familiarity with the Middle East recruitment market and regional hiring practices
* A client\-centric mindset with experience managing senior stakeholder relationships
* Proven ability to deliver against tight deadlines in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure environment
* Proficiency with ATS platforms and data\-driven recruitment tools
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
  


 Desirable
   

* CIPD qualification or equivalent HR/Recruitment certification
* Experience working on major infrastructure or construction programmes in the Middle East
  


**Additional Information**
  

 At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously.
 ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***
  

**About AECOM**
  

 AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, and service recognition awards.
   

  

 AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public\- and private\-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. Learn more at aecom.com.
   

  

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**
  

 You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects \- both in your local community and on a global scale \- that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting\-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award\-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

description:
About Superleap
 



  





 Superleap is the enterprise AI CRM that modern revenue teams need to unlock peak sales productivity. We are building Superleap CRM to be \- fast, easy/intuitive, flexible, and Intelligent.
 



  





 We compete in a $70B\+ global market and started in the $2B\+ India market. We intend to win by building the most robust AI CRM and the best service layer to ensure companies no longer hate their CRMs.
 



  





 Role Summary
 



  





 We are looking for a
 **Talent Acquisition Specialist** 
 to manage end\-to\-end recruitment, partner with hiring managers, and build strong talent pipelines across business functions. The role will involve
 **market mapping, sourcing, screening, stakeholder management, interview coordination, offer closure, and onboarding** 
 , while ensuring a positive candidate experience and timely hiring.
 



  





 The Problem We're Solving
 



  





 Most enterprise teams are currently held hostage by their own software. Instead of a tool that unlocks productivity, they deal with a "System of Record" that acts as a massive productivity burden.
 



  





 These legacy CRMs are static, unintuitive, and fundamentally disconnected from real operations. They’re "bolted\-on" with AI as an afterthought, rather than being built with intelligence at the core.
 



  





 Superleap is redefining the category by creating a "System of Intelligence" that is flexible, fast, and AI\-native. Our mission is to disrupt the CRM category by providing a 10x superior product and service that handles enterprise complexity at scale.
 



 Ideal Candidate
 



  





 We’re looking for a
 **Talent Acquisition Specialist with 3–8 years of experience** 
 who thinks beyond filling roles someone who understands the business, knows how to find exceptional talent, and can turn hiring challenges into successful closures.

* Have
 **3–8 years of hands\-on Talent Acquisition/Recruitment experience**

* Are passionate about

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
At Meolaa, tech talent is our bottleneck. We're building D2C infrastructure, data pipelines, marketplace integrations, and systems that need to scale from ₹1Cr to ₹100Cr ARR. We need someone who understands what good engineering looks like, can source in a competitive market, and moves fast without hiring people who'll slow us down.
 



 The role is Tech Recruiter.
 



 The reality is you own the engineering hiring roadmap, and you own quality.
 



  





 What does that actually mean?
 



 It means on Monday you're convincing a Backend engineer why Meolaa's problem is more interesting than the Stripe offer they just got.
 



 On Tuesday you're breaking down the CTO's roadmap into hiring needs how many DevOps engineers do we need for Q2?
 



 On Wednesday you're doing final interviews and making the call on your top 3 candidates.
 



 On Thursday you're handling competing offers and negotiating with engineers who have leverage.
 



 On Friday you're presenting hiring pipeline health to the CTO, candidate quality, time\-to\-hire, pipeline depth.
 



 No two weeks look the same. Every week you're moving the needle on team composition.
 



  





 What You'll Own
 



 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵 𝗧𝗮𝗹𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗲𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴
 


* Build and own Meolaa's employer brand in the tech community
* Source engineers from GitHub, communities, conferences, referrals not just LinkedIn
* Build relationships with engineering leaders and CTOs
* Know what's hot (AI engineers, DevOps) and what's cold (dying tech stacks)
* Be known as the person who connects good engineers to interesting problems



 𝗦𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗶𝗻𝗴 \& 𝗣𝗶𝗽𝗲𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲
 


* Build Boolean search strings that actually return quality candidates
* Source across roles — Backend, Frontend, DevOps, QA, Data engineers
* Maintain a warm pipeline of pre\-screened candidates (never scrambling)
* Know the difference between a good engineer and a good interviewer
* Build sourcing strategies for hard\-to\-fill roles (DevOps, ML engineers)



 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄𝗶𝗻𝗴 \& 𝗤𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝘵𝗿𝗼𝗹
 


* Screen candidates technically enough to know good from mediocre
* Brief your interview team on who's coming and what to probe
* Debrief after interviews and make hiring recommendations (not just pass candidates through)
* Own candidate experience make Meolaa a place people
 *want* 
 to work
* Flag red flags early if someone's a flight risk, you should see it



 𝗣𝗶𝗽𝗲𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲 𝗠𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁
 


* Own hiring timelines CTO says "I need a DevOps engineer by Month 3," you own that
* Maintain pipeline health 3–4 candidates in process for each open role
* Manage competing offers and counter\-offer strategically
* Keep candidates warm through the process — silence kills pipelines
* Own time\-to\-hire metrics and identify bottlenecks



 𝗥𝗲𝗰𝗿𝘂𝗶𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗦𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗴𝘆
 


* Work with the CTO to understand hiring needs before they feel the pain
* Build job descriptions that don't sound like every other startup post
* Coordinate with People Ops on compensation bands, offers, onboarding
* Track retention of hires you've made if they leave in 6 months, you know why
* Be a thought partner to engineering leadership on hiring strategy



 𝗢𝗻𝗯𝗼𝗮𝗿𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 \& 𝗥𝗲𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻
 


* Own first 90 days for engineering hires smooth onboarding, clear expectations
* Follow up on new hires at 30/60/90 days catch problems early
* Build relationships with engineers so they feel supported
* Flag flight risks and help leadership retain key people
* Track why people leave and feed insights back to improve hiring



  





 You might be the one if
 


* You have 3–6 years of tech recruiting experience
* You've filled engineering roles and built engineering teams
* You understand technology well enough to have real conversations with engineers
* You know the difference between full\-stack and backend, and why it matters
* You've sourced engineers outside LinkedIn (communities, GitHub, referrals)
* You've dealt with competing offers and know how to retain talent
* You can read a resume and know if someone's actually good or just has buzzwords
* Prior experience in D2C, startups, or consumer tech is a strong plus
* You know Bangalore's tech talent market — where they are, what they care about, what they're paid
* You think like a matchmaker you're matching people to problems they care about, not just filling positions



  





 Why Meolaa?
 



 We're building tech that's not trivial. D2C platform, marketplace integrations, supply chain visibility, data pipelines — engineers here solve real problems. That's attractive to good engineers. Your job is to find them and convince them this is more interesting than another FAANG role.
 



 You'll have a CTO who actually cares about hiring right. You'll have budget. And you'll have autonomy to source aggressively without permission at every step.
 



 This isn't a volume recruiting role.
 



 This is a quality hiring role at a company that values engineering.

Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

* 5–8 years of recruiting experience, with significant experience hiring for software engineering and technology organizations.
* Proven experience recruiting within technology product companies, SaaS, cloud, consumer technology, fintech, marketplaces, or other engineering\-led organizations.
* Ability to engage credibly with senior engineers and technical leaders and understand technology stacks, engineering environments, and technical career paths.

* Candidates currently based in Bangalore will be considered

**Job Description** 




**Sourcing Specialist \- Sales \& Leadership Hiring (North America)** 




**Location:** 
 Bangalore, India
 



**Shift:** 
 US Working Hours (North America Time Zones)
 



**Experience:** 
 5\-10 Years of Post\-MBA Experience
 



**Education:** 
 MBA / PGDM in Human Resources from a recognized institution
 



**Industry Preference:** 
 IT Services, Digital Engineering, Technology Consulting, Managed Services, Cloud, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, BPO, or Technology Solutions organizations
 



**About the Role** 




 We are seeking a highly driven and research\-oriented Sourcing Specialist to support leadership and sales hiring across North America. The role focuses on identifying, engaging, and building high\-quality talent pipelines for strategic sales, business development, practice leadership, delivery leadership, and executive\-level positions within the IT Services and Technology Solutions industry.
 



 The successful candidate will be responsible for proactive talent mapping, market intelligence, competitive research, passive candidate engagement, and creating strong candidate pipelines for critical leadership and revenue\-generating roles.
 



 The position is based in Bangalore and requires collaboration with hiring managers, recruitment teams, and business leaders across the US. Therefore, flexibility to work during US business hours is essential.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Strategic Talent Sourcing** 



* Build and maintain strong pipelines of Sales, Client Partner, Account Management, Practice Leadership, Delivery Leadership, Consulting, and Executive talent across North America.
* Conduct extensive talent mapping of target organizations, competitors, and industry\-leading firms.
* Identify and engage passive candidates through various sourcing channels and networking platforms.
* Develop sourcing strategies for niche and hard\-to\-find leadership talent.



**Market Research \& Competitive Intelligence** 



* Perform market mapping and organizational research across IT Services, Consulting, Digital Engineering, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Data \& Analytics, Infrastructure, AI, and Technology Services sectors.
* Track leadership movements, organizational changes, succession opportunities, and competitor talent landscapes.
* Generate talent intelligence reports and insights for recruiters and hiring leaders.

* Conduct initial outreach and build relationships with prospective candidates.

* Build long\-term talent communities for recurring strategic hiring needs.
* Maintain active databases of leadership and sales candidates.
* Create and regularly update talent pools segmented by industry, geography, functional expertise, and leadership level.



**Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to understand hiring priorities.
* Participate in hiring strategy discussions and talent reviews.
* Provide market intelligence and competitor benchmarking to stakeholders.



**Recruitment Analytics \& Reporting** 



* Track sourcing effectiveness through productivity metrics.
* Maintain sourcing dashboards and pipeline reports.
* Analyze market trends, talent availability, and hiring challenges.



**Employer Branding \& Networking** 



* Represent the organization professionally during candidate interactions.
* Participate in industry communities, networking forums, and talent engagement initiatives.
* Support employer branding efforts aimed at attracting senior sales and leadership talent.



  





**Target Roles to Source** 




 The Sourcing Specialist will focus on roles such as:
 



**Sales Leadership** 



* Client Partner
* Strategic Account Manager
* Account Director
* Sales Director
* Sales Vice President
* Industry Vertical Leader
* Business Development Director
* Portfolio Leader



**Practice \& Technology Leadership** 



* Practice Head
* Consulting Leader
* Delivery Director
* Delivery Vice President
* Global Capability Center (GCC) Leader
* Digital Transformation Leader
* Cloud \& Infrastructure Leader
* Cybersecurity Leader
* AI \& Data Practice Leader



**Executive Hiring** 



* Vice President
* Senior Vice President
* Business Unit Head
* Practice Head
* Global Delivery Leader
* Country/Regional Leaders



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 




**Experience** 



* 5\-10 years of post\-MBA experience in Talent Acquisition or Executive Search.
* Proven experience sourcing leadership and sales professionals.
* Experience supporting North America hiring mandates.
* Strong expertise in passive candidate sourcing and market mapping.
* Exposure to executive search assignments will be highly preferred.
* Prior experience in an IT Services or Technology Services organization is an advantage.



**Skills** 



* Executive Search
* Leadership Hiring
* Sales Hiring
* Talent Mapping
* Market Intelligence
* Competitive Research
* LinkedIn Recruiter
* Boolean Search Techniques
* Candidate Engagement
* Stakeholder Management
* Talent Analytics
* Workforce Intelligence



**Behavioral Competencies** 



* Strong research and analytical skills
* High attention to detail
* Excellent verbal and written communication
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Strong networking and relationship\-building abilities
* Results\-oriented and highly proactive mindset
* Ability to operate in a fast\-paced global environment



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* Number of qualified leadership profiles generated per month
* Leadership pipeline conversion rate
* Sales candidate submission\-to\-interview ratio
* Time\-to\-source for critical roles
* Diversity of talent pipelines
* Talent mapping coverage of target competitors
* Hiring manager satisfaction scores

* Source channel productivity

**Why Join Us** 




 This role provides an opportunity to work closely with senior business leaders and influence strategic hiring decisions across North America. You will play a critical role in building leadership talent pipelines that directly contribute to business growth, market expansion, and organizational success.

**Preferences**
* 7–10 years of experience in Workday HCM delivery, with strong functional depth in Talent, Performance, and Learning.
* Mandatory Workday Talent \& Performance certification and Workday Learning certification.
* Experience delivering multiple Workday Talent, Performance, and/or Learning implementations, enhancements, or optimization initiatives across key project phases.
* Strong understanding of Talent and Performance processes, including employee reviews, calibrations, goals, succession planning, talent reviews, development planning, and reporting.
* Strong understanding of Learning processes, including learning administration, content setup, campaigns, programs, assignments, enrollments, compliance learning, and learner experience.

* Experience mentoring and reviewing the work of team members, including consultants and senior consultants.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Experience Management – Supervising Associate**
**About Global Delivery Services:**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity:**
 As a part of a team, you will act as a Resource Management Hub Deputy Manager who provides consistent, high quality services to key individual stakeholders.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities:**
* Service Delivery Leadership:
+ Manage end\-to\-end resource fulfilment, ensuring alignment with delivery timelines and business priorities.
+ Oversee billing and finance operations related to resource deployment, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
+ Own headcount planning to support growth and efficiency.
+ Champion and lead Strategic Experience Management initiatives, aligning resource strategy with long\-term business objectives.
+ Monitor and improve service levels, turnaround times, and stakeholder satisfaction.

* Planning \& Optimization:
+ Forecast demand and plan capacity across skill sets.
+ Maximize bench utilization and redeployment efficiency.
+ Collaborate with Talent Acquisition and HR to align hiring plans with pipeline and delivery needs.

* Performance Management:
+ Establish and track KPIs for resource performance, utilization, and productivity.
+ Conduct regular reviews with delivery leads to assess individual and team performance.

* Stakeholder Management:
+ Act as a strategic partner to delivery, business leaders.
+ Facilitate governance forums to review resource allocation, pipeline, and performance metrics.
+ Resolve escalations related to staffing conflicts, skill mismatches, or delivery risks.

* Data \& Analytics:
+ Maintain accurate dashboards and reports on resource availability, utilization, and forecasting.
+ Use data\-driven insights to inform decision\-making and identify improvement opportunities.


**Skills and attributes for success:**
* Hands on knowledge on End to End Resource management
* Be proficient in MS Project/Word/PowerPoint/Excel \- working knowledge of MS office
* Knowledge in Data Visualisation tools would be an added advantage
* Exceptional communication skills \- both written and oral
* Demonstrate strong organizational skills and structured thinking abilities
* Demonstrate strong interpersonal and analytical skills
* Demonstrate an eye for detail
* Be flexible and willing to adjust responsibilities to align with developing business needs
* Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity and rapid change


**To qualify for the role, you must have:**
* Graduate / MBA (HR) with 12\-14 years of overall experience with 8\+ years of relevant experience in E2E resource management, deployment, forecasting and scheduling concepts.
* Exposure of short term and long\-term resource planning would be an added advantage.


**What we look for:**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be part of a market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunity to work with EY GDS practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What we offer you:**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Manager, Talent Acquisition (Skillz)
description:
**About The Company**
 If you want to build, own, and see your impact — join Skillz and level up your career.
   

  

 Skillz is the competition infrastructure platform that powers real\-money, skill\-based tournaments inside mobile games. We didn't just enter the competitive gaming market — we invented it. Founded in 2012 by entrepreneur and inventor Andrew Paradise, Skillz built the category from scratch: the patented matchmaking, identity, payments, fraud protection, and developer tools that make fair, real\-stakes competition possible at scale.
   

  

 Skillz hosts billions of casual mobile gaming tournaments for millions of players worldwide and is revolutionizing the gaming industry. By fostering social competition within games, the Skillz platform helps developers build multi\-million dollar franchises by enabling real\-money activity in their games and providing operational support while connecting players through fair, enjoyable, and meaningful competition.
   

  

 Today, Skillz is part of FIRY — a global holding company operating at the intersection of gaming, AI\-powered performance marketing, and developer infrastructure. Alongside RZR, our AI\-driven ad network, and Beamable, our backend and LiveOps platform, Skillz sits at the center of a compounding data flywheel that no standalone competitor can replicate. 800,000\+ daily tournaments. $7\.5 billion in lifetime prizes paid to players. 90 million registered users.
   

  

 We're a high\-conviction team of builders who came from Apple, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Tesla, X, Roblox, Zynga, Samsung, Lyft, EA, Riot, Nexon, Gameskraft, PlayStation, Unity, Scopely, Tinder, Intel, Deloitte, EY, Twitch, DraftKings, Wynn Resorts, and more. We operate like a startup, hold ourselves to high standards, and move fast with purpose. If you want to work on infrastructure that matters — and be part of a team that fights for what it builds — Skillz is the right place.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Skillz is looking for a Manager, Talent Acquisition to join our Bangalore team as second\-in\-command to the Senior Manager, TA. This is a hybrid role that blends hands\-on recruiting with day\-to\-day team leadership. You'll own priority searches yourself while coaching and guiding a team of recruiters to hire high\-quality talent across our technical and business functions.
   

  

 You'll play a direct role in driving recruiting profitability: cutting time\-to\-fill, growing our direct\-sourcing capability, and reducing our reliance on external agencies. At the same time, you'll build team capacity through coaching, consistent hiring standards, and hands\-on problem\-solving — stepping in as the Senior Manager's delegate to keep recruitment operations running smoothly as hiring demand grows.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Act as second\-in\-command to the Senior Manager, TA; serve as their delegate, ensuring continuity of recruitment operations, and escalating risks in their absence.
* Own full\-cycle recruiting for priority and hard\-to\-fill roles across technical, product, data, and business functions, with an emphasis on sourcing Tier 1 talent from B2C technology companies.
* Provide day\-to\-day leadership to a team of recruiters including coaching, setting clear expectations, reviewing performance, and delivering feedback that improves productivity.
* Build and maintain direct\-sourcing pipelines and market maps to reduce agency dependency and raise quality of hire.
* Partner with hiring managers and senior leaders to turn workforce priorities into structured search strategies and measurable hiring plans, constructively pushing back on requirements when needed.
* Track funnel metrics, conversion rates, and requisition ageing to spot bottlenecks and resolve operational blockers across the team's portfolio.
* Uphold hiring standards and process consistency to protect candidate experience and hit timelines.
* Lead offer negotiations and closing conversations, managing compensation expectations and counteroffers to land great talent within budget.
* Build lasting relationships with candidates, recruiters, hiring managers, and stakeholders across the business.
* Support the Senior Manager, TA in driving down time\-to\-fill and minimizing the productivity loss that comes with open roles.


**Key Competencies**
* Team Leadership \& Coaching — guiding recruiters, setting expectations, and improving team performance.
* Technical \& Business Acumen — fluent in evaluating engineering, product, and data talent from Tier 1 B2C companies.
* Strategic Recruiting — translating priorities into search strategies, market maps, and hiring plans.
* Stakeholder Management — building credibility with leaders and constructively challenging requirements.
* Execution \& Accountability — strong ownership of outcomes, timelines, and candidate experience.
* Data\-Driven Decision\-Making — using metrics to spot risk and improve outcomes.
* Problem\-Solving \& Adaptability — resolving bottlenecks and thriving amid shifting priorities.
* Offer Negotiation \& Closing — managing compensation conversations and counteroffers with confidence.
* Relationship Building — sustaining trust across candidates, recruiters, and stakeholders.


**Experience**
* 8\+ years of full\-cycle recruiting experience, with a strong track record hiring technical, product, data, or business talent.
* 1–2\+ years formally managing, mentoring, or leading recruiters day\-to\-day.
* Demonstrated success hiring Tier 1 talent from B2C technology, consumer internet, gaming, fintech, e\-commerce, travel\-tech, food\-tech, or other scaled consumer businesses.
* Experience running priority or hard\-to\-fill searches independently while overseeing other recruiters' delivery.
* Strong direct\-sourcing skills; experience with building market maps and proactive pipelines without heavy reliance on agencies.
* End\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle experience: sourcing, screening, interview coordination, debriefs, references, negotiation, closing, and onboarding.
* Background in a startup, turnaround, or fast\-scaling environment where priorities shift quickly.
* A track record of tenure and growth; ideally two\-plus years at one or more organizations, with internal promotions or expanded scope.
* Genuine interest in gaming, consumer technology, and digital products.
* Based in Bangalore, or willing to relocate and work regularly from the Skillz Bangalore office.
* Background hiring for B2C tier\-1 profiles at B2C tech companies (not consulting/agency\-side).


**Location:** 
 Hybrid in Bangalore, India
   

  

**Travel Requirement:** 
 Less than 10%
   

  

**Why Skillz**
* You're building infrastructure, not just features. Skillz is the competition layer for mobile gaming — the matchmaking, payments, identity, and fraud systems that make real\-stakes competition trustworthy at scale. The work here compounds. Every improvement to the platform makes every tournament on it better.
* Founder\-led. Andrew Paradise founded Skillz in 2012 with a single conviction: that fair, real\-money skill\-based competition should exist at scale. Thirteen years later, he’s taken the company public on the NYSE, built a portfolio of three independent businesses, earned 90\+ patents, and won the largest false advertising verdict in U.S. history. He is still here — still the founder, still the CEO, still building. That kind of long\-term commitment and alignment is rare in any company. At Skillz, it defines the culture from the top down.
* Part of a compounding ecosystem. Skillz is one of three businesses inside FIRY — alongside RZR, our AI\-powered performance ad network, and Beamable, our developer backend platform. Your work spans gaming, ad tech, identity, payments, and ecommerce. The platform you build on gets smarter and more valuable with every player, developer, and advertiser that enters the ecosystem.
* Comprehensive Benefits. 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. 401K matching, equity incentives, pre\-tax benefit options, and more.
* Wellness Support. Meditation and mental health resources, physical fitness coaching and classes, family planning assistance, health and parenting guidance, virtual therapy sessions, and more.
* Time Off. Competitive PTO and company holidays.
* Las Vegas Headquarters. Skillz operates in a five\-day\-a\-week, collaborative office environment at our 36,000\+ square foot Las Vegas HQ. Free daily catered lunch, snacks, a full\-size gym with showers, commuter benefits, team events, and more.
* Recognized Success. Skillz has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, CNBC's Disruptor 50, San Francisco Business Times' Best Places to Work, Forbes' Next Billion\-Dollar Startups, and the \#1 fastest\-growing company in America on the Inc. 5000 list, and many more.


 Join Skillz and Let's Redefine the Boundaries of Gaming!
   

  

 Together, we'll create a world where skill, passion, and innovation thrive. We look forward to having you on board!
   

  

 Skillz embraces diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance
 *.*

description:
ABOUT THE ROLE
 



  





 Miles Education is looking for a Talent Acquisition professional to own lateral hiring portfolio, reporting directly to the VP\-HR. This is not a high\-volume recruiting role. It is a targeted headhunting mandate for roles where there is no inbound applicant pool to draw from: leadership hires, specialized functional roles, and positions where the wrong hire has outsized cost.
 



  





 The candidate should be someone who has run executive or specialist searches independently, is comfortable being the credible voice in the room with function heads, and reports on search progress with the same rigor a retained search firm would.
 



  





 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 ● Own end\-to\-end hiring for all lateral and niche requirements.
 



 ● Build and execute lateral sourcing strategy: direct headhunting, market mapping, executive networks, LinkedIn Recruiter, niche platforms.
 



 ● Run searches independently for roles with no meaningful inbound pipeline.
 



 ● Own time\-to\-close and quality\-of\-hire for every search, with data to defend both.
 



 ● Report directly to VP\-HR on every active search: pipeline status, market realities, risk flags.
 



 ● Partner with function heads to pressure\-test role briefs before a search opens, not after it stalls.
 



 ● Push back on unrealistic briefs (comp, timeline, candidate profile) with market evidence, not deference.
 



 ● Build and maintain live talent maps for specialist roles.
 



 ● Track competitor hiring, comp benchmarks, and talent movement relevant to Miles' functions.
 



 ● Maintain a warm bench of passive candidates ahead of anticipated openings, not after a req opens.
 



 ● Own the full candidate lifecycle for every lateral hire, from first outreach to offer close.
 



 ● Represent Miles credibly to senior, passive candidates who are not actively jobhunting.
 



 ● Maintain accurate requisition and pipeline data in the ATS (Zoho/equivalent).
 



 ● Ensure offer documentation and onboarding handoffs meet Miles' HR compliance standards.
 



  





 IDEAL CANDIDATE
 



  





 ● 6\-8 years in recruitment, with demonstrable lateral experience for mid\-to\-senior or leadership roles, not primarily bulk or inbound hiring.
 



 ● Has run searches with zero applicant pipeline and closed them through direct outreach.
 



 ● Credible one\-on\-one with function heads and senior leadership; not intimidated by pushing back on a bad brief.
 



 ● Comfortable reporting directly to VP\-HR with search\-level detail, not just funnel counts.
 



 ● Sharp on comp benchmarking and market realism; won't let a hiring manager's wishlist go unchallenged.
 



  





 PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
 



  





 ● Prior experience in an executive search firm, RPO, or a lean in\-house TA team running senior searches
 



 independently.
 



 ● Exposure to EdTech, professional services, or fast\-scaling organizations.
 



 ● Experience operating without a large sourcing team behind them.
 



  





 WHY JOIN MILES
 



  





 This role sits outside the high\-volume Inside Sales hiring engine and reports directly to the VP\-HR, giving you direct ownership and visibility on the searches that shape Miles' leadership bench.
 



  





 Please note this is a 6 days work from office based role. We are located in Koramangala, Bangalore.

* Attention to detail and accuracy

* Ownership and follow\-through
* Confidentiality and integrity
* Employee\-centric approach
* Problem\-solving skills
* Time\-management

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist (Tech)
description:
**Please do not apply unless you have prior experience working in a startup or high\-paced, high\-ownership environment.** 




  





**Role: Talent Acquisition Specialist (Tech)** 




**Location: HSR Layout, Bengaluru** 




**Experience: 2–3 years** 




**Joining: Immediate joiners preferred** 




**Work Mode: Full\-time, On\-site** 




  





**About Recrivio** 




 Recrivio is a technology\-enabled talent solutions company helping startups, scale\-ups and enterprises build high\-quality teams across permanent hiring, contract staffing, C2H and offshore team building.
 



  





 We are building a high\-performance recruitment team where recruiters are expected to own outcomes, move fast and operate with a strong sense of urgency.
 



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




 We are specifically looking for someone who has
 **built their recruitment experience in a startup / high\-growth environment** 
 .
 



 This is important.
 



 We are NOT looking for someone whose experience has primarily been in a large, highly structured corporate environment with narrowly defined recruitment responsibilities.
 



  





**You should be someone who is used to:** 



* Working with aggressive hiring targets
* Managing multiple roles simultaneously
* Operating with limited hand\-holding
* Handling changing priorities
* Working directly with founders, hiring managers and business teams
* Taking ownership from sourcing to closure
* Working under tight TATs
* Solving recruitment problems independently
* Being measured on actual hires, not just CV submissions



  





**The Role** 




 As a Tech Recruiter, you will own the recruitment lifecycle for technology roles from understanding the requirement and building the sourcing strategy to screening, interview management, offer negotiation and joining.
 



  





**You will work across roles such as:** 



* Backend / Frontend / Full Stack Engineering
* Software Engineering
* DevOps / Cloud
* Data / AI / ML
* QA / Automation
* Product \& other technology roles



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Understand technical requirements and hiring priorities deeply
* Build sourcing strategies for every requirement
* Source aggressively through LinkedIn, Naukri, referrals, databases and other channels
* Screen candidates for technical relevance, career trajectory, motivation, compensation and availability
* Build high\-quality candidate pipelines
* Drive candidates through the interview process
* Own candidate follow\-ups and engagement
* Manage offer negotiations and closure
* Drive offer\-to\-join conversions
* Maintain accurate recruitment funnel data
* Work closely with Account Managers / BD / Hiring Managers
* Build talent pools for recurring and difficult technology requirements
* Identify funnel bottlenecks and independently solve them



  





**Must\-Haves** 



* **2–3 years of hands\-on technology recruitment experience**
* **Mandatory: Prior experience working in a startup / high\-growth company / recruitment startup or high\-intensity staffing environment**
* Strong experience hiring technology professionals
* Strong sourcing capability across LinkedIn and Naukri
* Ability to understand technical requirements beyond keyword matching
* Strong candidate assessment and communication skills
* Proven ability to handle multiple requirements simultaneously
* Strong ownership and follow\-through
* Target\-driven mindset
* Strong candidate closing and negotiation skills
* **Immediate joiner or very short notice period preferred**



  





**We Will Value You If** 




 You can confidently say:
 



 “Give me a difficult tech requirement and a deadline. I'll figure out how to build the pipeline.”
 



 You don't wait for perfect requirements, perfect candidates or perfect processes.
 



 You figure things out.
 



 You know how to identify why a role isn't moving, change your sourcing strategy, improve conversions and push a candidate from first conversation to joining.
 



  





**What We Don't Want** 



* Recruiters who only forward CVs
* People who need constant follow\-ups from their manager
* Purely coordination\-focused recruiters
* Candidates without meaningful technology hiring exposure
* Candidates coming exclusively from slow, highly structured recruitment environments
* People who measure their work by activity rather than hiring outcomes



  





**How You'll Be Measured** 




 Performance will be measured primarily on:
 


* Quality of submissions
* Interviews generated
* Offers closed
* Offer\-to\-join conversion
* Hiring TAT
* Candidate quality
* Client / hiring\-manager feedback
* Achievement of hiring targets



  





 In short
 



**2–3 years experience. Strong tech recruitment. Startup environment. High ownership. High intensity. Immediate joiner preferred.** 




  





 If you've thrived in a startup where
 **speed, targets and outcomes matter** 
 , we'd like to talk.

description:
**Role:** 
 Talent Acquisition Associate
 



**Start Date:** 
 October 2026
 



**Location:** 
 Onsite in HSR, Bangalore
 



  





**About KAVI** 




 Professional investors need to understand businesses before they back them — and the best way to do that is to talk to people who've actually built and run them. That's what we do. We connect investors with industry experts, then turn those conversations into a searchable library covering business models, competitive dynamics, and market trends.
 



  





 Over 100 investment firms, managing more than USD 100 billion in assets, rely on what we publish.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We know exactly who we want on this team. Until now, we've been finding them the way small companies do: late, and only when something breaks. You're here to change that.
 



  





 You'll own hiring end to end: finding the people, running the process, and closing the ones we want. You'll be the first person a candidate speaks to, and the bridge between them and the rest of the team. Along the way you'll also handle the smaller people things that come with a growing company — onboarding, paperwork, the occasional "who do I ask about this?"
 



  





 This is an entry\-level role. The process, the tools, the way we work — all of that we'll teach you. What we can't teach is judgement about people: reading a CV and knowing what it isn't saying, sensing within 5 minutes of a call whether someone is sharp or just polished, telling the difference between nervous and unprepared. That's the part you need to bring.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Run hiring from start to finish: source candidates, screen, schedule, interview, and make offers
* Be the candidate's guide through the process — clear, quick, and honest at every step
* Build and maintain a pipeline so we're never starting from zero when a role opens
* Handle onboarding and the basic HR admin that keeps a small team running smoothly



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* A degree in any discipline — psychology, business, or HR is a plus, but curiosity matters more
* 0–2 years of experience; internships in recruiting, campus placement, or people\-facing roles all count
* A genuine read on people: you notice things in conversation that others miss
* Organised enough to run several searches at once without letting a candidate fall through the cracks

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
**About NewSpace Research \& Technologies (NRT):** 




  





 NewSpace Research \& Technologies (NRT) is India’s leading Aerospace \& Defence innovation company developing next\-generation autonomous systems, AI\-driven aerial platforms, and advanced technologies for defence and dual\-use applications.
 



  





 Our teams work at the intersection of engineering, product development, and manufacturing, solving complex real\-world problems with speed, precision, and purpose. Our portfolio includes intelligent uncrewed systems such as Autonomous Swarming Drones, Collaborative Combat Aerial Vehicles (CCAV), Tethered Platforms, High\-Altitude Pseudo Satellites (HAPS), Loitering Munitions, and many more.
 



  





 With 500\+ engineers across R\&D and manufacturing, we collaborate with leading Indian and global Defence \& Aerospace organizations to build the future of autonomous systems.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We’re looking for a hands\-on, strategic HR Business Partner to work closely with leaders across engineering, product, and manufacturing functions — the teams shaping India’s next generation of aerospace and technology systems.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a high\-performance, high\-velocity environment, understands technology and manufacturing cultures, and can translate business goals into people strategies. You’ll partner with leaders to shape the organization’s capability, drive performance, ensure compliance, and enhance the overall employee experience — while staying deeply grounded in day\-to\-day HR execution.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. Strategic Business Partnering
 



 • Partner with functional heads to align people priorities with business objectives, ensuring workforce readiness and capability for upcoming projects.
 



 • Drive organization design, manpower planning, and succession strategies aligned to growth.
 



 • Use HR analytics and insights to support data\-driven decision\-making around talent and engagement.
 



 • Act as a trusted advisor to leaders on talent performance, structure, and employee relations.
 



  





 2\. Talent \& Capability Development
 



 • Work closely with the TA function to ensure timely onboarding of the right talent for each function.
 



 • Own the onboarding and assimilation experience, ensuring new hires have clear 90\-day plans and connect well with their teams.
 



 • Identify key skill gaps and coordinate with L\&D to design upskilling, reskilling, and leadership development interventions.
 



 • Support career progression and internal mobility frameworks.
 



  





 3\. Performance \& Rewards
 



 • Lead the performance management cycle – goal setting, continuous feedback, appraisal discussions, and performance improvement plans.
 



 • Partner with the compensation team to drive salary reviews, benchmarking, and rewards programs.
 



 • Support the implementation of variable pay, incentive, and recognition frameworks.
 



 • Ensure internal equity and consistency in compensation and progression decisions.
 



  





 4\. Employee Relations \& Engagement
 



 • Foster a culture of openness, inclusion, and performance accountability.
 



 • Lead employee engagement and communication initiatives that enhance morale and retention across sites.
 



 • Manage grievances, employee relations cases, and workplace conflict with fairness and discretion.
 



 • Conduct skip\-level connects, stay interviews, and feedback sessions to identify engagement drivers.
 



  





 5\. HR Operations, Payroll \& Compliance
 



 • Partner with HR Operations to ensure timely and accurate payroll inputs, employee records, and documentation.
 



 • Ensure smooth handling of HRIS, attendance, and compliance activities across employment categories (permanent, contract, consultants).
 



 • Work closely with Finance for payroll audits, budget validation, and manpower cost controls.
 



 • Oversee policy implementation, discipline cases, and ensure adherence to all applicable labour laws and new codes.
 



  





 6\. Administrative \& Site HR Responsibilities
 



 • Manage on\-ground administrative HR tasks — employee data updates, vendor HR coordination, and HR\-related communication for the BU/site.
 



 • Ensure all HR activities at the business unit or facility level run smoothly — from attendance tracking to compliance checks.
 



 • Support logistics for employee onboarding, travel reimbursements, events, and welfare programs.
 



  





**Skills \& Attributes** 




  





 • Strong business acumen and understanding of engineering/manufacturing environments.
 



 • Proven ability to balance strategic influence and operational execution.
 



 • Experience driving performance, rewards, and engagement frameworks in a fast\-paced tech setup.
 



 • High ownership, agility, and comfort in managing multiple priorities.
 



 • Excellent interpersonal, analytical, and communication skills.
 



 • Proficiency with HRMS tools, payroll systems, spreadsheets, and HR analytics dashboards.
 



  





**Experience \& Qualification** 




  





 • Master’s degree in Human Resources or Business Management (Engineering background preferred).
 



 • 8–10 years of total HR experience, with a minimum of 5 years in an HRBP role supporting technology, product, or manufacturing functions.
 



 • Experience in deep\-tech, aerospace, or advanced manufacturing organizations is a strong plus.

title: Recruiting Coordinator
description:
**About Ethos**
 Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three\-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for two Recruiting Coordinators based in India to support our fast\-growing US Talent team. Working night shift hours to overlap with our Pacific Time\-based hiring teams, you'll play a critical role in delivering a seamless, world\-class candidate experience while helping our recruiters and hiring managers move quickly and efficiently.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
* Ensure every candidate has a world\-class interview experience from first contact through offer
* Schedule a high volume of phone, virtual, and onsite interviews across hiring teams, executives, and candidates spanning multiple US time zones
* Coordinate travel logistics for non\-local candidates as needed
* Support day\-of interview logistics (virtual coordination, rescheduling, real\-time troubleshooting) to keep interviews running on time
* Manage candidate flow and data integrity through our Applicant Tracking System (Greenhouse)
* Serve as a point of contact for candidates and interviewers, providing clear, timely communication across time zones
* Support employer brand efforts by partnering with marketing and design on internal/external career page content
* Help organize and support virtual recruiting events, acting as a brand ambassador for Ethos


**Qualifications And Skills**
* 3\-5 years of experience in Recruiting Coordination, Recruiting, or People Operations
* Working knowledge of Greenhouse (ATS) and ModernLoop (or similar interview scheduling/automation tools)
* Experience supporting or working with a US\-based team, with strong cross\-time\-zone communication skills
* Comfortable and reliable working night shift hours on an ongoing basis
* High attention to detail in all candidate and stakeholder interactions
* Personable, professional, and able to maintain a positive attitude under shifting, high\-volume circumstances
* Strong organizational skills and a creative approach to problem\-solving
* Reliable internet connectivity and a suitable remote work setup for night\-shift operations


 Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records.
   

  

 To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice.
   

  

***Recruitment Notice: Please be aware of recruitment scams. All legitimate communication from our team will only come from email addresses ending in @ethos.com or @getethos.com.***
***We will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent us from a different email address, please treat it as fraudulent.***
